channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Our Opinion: Wilson's whimsical whirligigs earn top USA Today honor
item.description: Thumbs up to the Vollis Simpson Whirligig Park for being named the country's No. 1 sculpture park by readers of USA Today; thumbs down to the city of Rocky Mount for overspending detailed in a report from State Auditor Dave Boliek's office.

item.title: Herrera-Picasso sets example for Wilson City Council colleagues
item.description: A Wilson Democratic leader praises Councilman Herrera-Picasso's professional agenda request, criticizes colleagues' leaks and conduct and says recent elections show voters are rejecting decades of status quo.

item.title: Disagreement is part of democracy; threats and intimidation are not
item.description: Wilson Councilman James M. Johnson III condemns threats against a colleague over a proposed discussion and urges the community to support respectful dialogue among council members.

item.title: MEET THE WARBIRDS: Front Office Edition
item.description: Meet Mike Pittman, a Tarboro native and food and beverage coordinator who shares his baseball background, favorite player Mark McGwire, and athletic milestones from Little League to a football state title.

item.title: Woman gets 16-20 years in murder plea
item.description: A Goldsboro woman gets 16-20 years after pleading guilty to second-degree murder in a 2023 fatal shooting at a Wilson motel; two men receive obstruction sentences tied to the case.

item.title: Council moving breakfast meetings to City Hall
item.description: Wilson City Council will move its monthly breakfast meeting to City Hall so sessions can be televised, aiming to improve public access and transparency.

item.title: Fire damages Vestal Hall at school for the deaf
item.description: A roof fire at Eastern North Carolina School for the Deaf forces temporary classroom moves; no injuries reported as officials assess smoke and water damage to elementary and middle school areas.

item.title: Area Calendar, March 10-11, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for March 10-11, 2026, featuring Barton college matchups and a full slate of local high school baseball, softball, soccer, tennis, golf, track and girls basketball.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Bruins blast Spartans 16-1 for 3rd win
item.description: Beddingfield softball routed Smithfield-Selma 16-1 for its third win in four games, while Southern Nash, Community Christian and Fike teams also notched victories in area play.
